build_PositionEmbeddingSine: build a PositionEmbeddingSine module with num_pos_feats to generate sinusoidal positional encodings for image features
create_PositionEmbeddingRandom: create a PositionEmbeddingRandom module using random spatial frequencies for positional encoding of grid coordinates
test_encode_points: test the encode_points method to positionally encode batched point coordinates with labels using sine embeddings
test_encode_boxes: test the encode_boxes method to positionally encode bounding box coordinates with width and height using sine embeddings
apply_apply_rotary_enc: apply rotary positional encoding to query and key tensors using precomputed complex frequency cis values
